metadata.question: Was the nighttime brightness over northern part of Isabela Island greater than the southern part of Isabela Island at 1:20 am local time on January 7, 2022?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy: Use VIIRS Nighttime Lights monthly composite (NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V21/VCMSLCFG) for January 2022 over Isabela Island, Galápagos (geometry from FAO/GAUL/2015/level2, fallback to a tight rectangle if needed). Split island geometry into north/south halves by mid-latitude of its bounding box.
2. Masking strategy: Not a cloud question; use land mask from JRC Global Surface Water to exclude ocean. Monthly composite is already cloud-reduced.
3. Valid Zero vs Null/Error: Check collection sizes; if empty after attempts -> C1. Compute pixel counts after masking; if zero in any half -> C2. If mean results come back null/NaN -> C3. Catch dataset/band errors -> D.
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  function ev(obj) {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      obj.evaluate((res, err) => (err ? reject(err) : resolve(res)));
    });
  }

  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const dateStart = '2022-01-01';
    const dateEnd = '2022-02-01'; // January 2022
    // Try to get Isabela Island from GAUL L2 (Ecuador > Galapagos > Isabela)
    const gaul2 = ee.FeatureCollection('FAO/GAUL/2015/level2');
    const isabelaFC = gaul2
      .filter(ee.Filter.eq('ADM0_NAME', 'Ecuador'))
      .filter(ee.Filter.or(
        ee.Filter.eq('ADM1_NAME', 'Galapagos'),
        ee.Filter.eq('ADM1_NAME', 'Galápagos')
      ))
      .filter(ee.Filter.stringContains('ADM2_NAME', 'Isabela'));
    const gaulCount = await ev(isabelaFC.size());
    console.log(`GAUL Isabela features: ${gaulCount}`);

    let islandGeom;
    let geomSource = 'GAUL';
    if (gaulCount && gaulCount > 0) {
      islandGeom = isabelaFC.geometry().dissolve(1);
    } else {
      // Fallback: a tight rectangle around Isabela to avoid Fernandina to the west
      islandGeom = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([-91.42, -1.45, -90.85, 0.25], null, false);
      geomSource = 'RectFallback';
    }
    console.log(`Using geometry: ${geomSource}`);

    // Split island into North/South halves by mid-latitude of bounding box
    const bbox = islandGeom.bounds(1);
    const ring = ee.List(ee.List(bbox.coordinates().get(0)));
    const ll = ee.List(ring.get(0));
    const ur = ee.List(ring.get(2));
    const xMin = ee.Number(ll.get(0));
    const yMin = ee.Number(ll.get(1));
    const xMax = ee.Number(ur.get(0));
    const yMax = ee.Number(ur.get(1));
    const midY = yMin.add(yMax).divide(2);
    const northGeom = islandGeom.intersection(ee.Geometry.Rectangle([xMin, midY, xMax, yMax]), 1);
    const southGeom = islandGeom.intersection(ee.Geometry.Rectangle([xMin, yMin, xMax, midY]), 1);

    // Land mask (exclude ocean): non-water using GSW occurrence < 10
    const gsw = ee.Image('JRC/GSW1_4/GlobalSurfaceWater');
    const landMask = gsw.select('occurrence').lt(10);

    // 2. Data Acquisition & Check (Monthly VIIRS)
    let col = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V21/VCMSLCFG')
      .filterDate(dateStart, dateEnd)
      .filterBounds(islandGeom);
    let nV21 = await ev(col.size());
    console.log(`Monthly V21 Jan 2022 Images: ${nV21}`);
    if (!nV21 || nV21 === 0) {
      // Fallback to older version
      col = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG')
        .filterDate(dateStart, dateEnd)
        .filterBounds(islandGeom);
      const nV1 = await ev(col.size());
      console.log(`Monthly V1 Jan 2022 Images: ${nV1}`);
      if (!nV1 || nV1 === 0) {
        console.log('No monthly VIIRS images found for Jan 2022 in ROI.');
        console.log('C1');
        return;
      }
    }

    const img = ee.Image(col.first()).select(['avg_rad']).updateMask(landMask);

    // 3. Processing: Pixel counts to detect C2
    async function getStats(geom) {
      const countDic = await ev(img.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: geom,
        scale: 1000,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      }));
      const meanDic = await ev(img.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
        geometry: geom,
        scale: 1000,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      }));
      const count = countDic ? (countDic.avg_rad || 0) : 0;
      const meanVal = meanDic ? meanDic.avg_rad : null;
      return { count, meanVal };
    }

    const northStats = await getStats(northGeom);
    const southStats = await getStats(southGeom);

    if ((northStats.count === 0) || (southStats.count === 0)) {
      console.log(`North pixels: ${northStats.count}, South pixels: ${southStats.count}`);
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }

    // 4. Calculation: Validate means
    const northMean = northStats.meanVal;
    const southMean = southStats.meanVal;

    const isValidNumber = (v) => (typeof v === 'number') && isFinite(v);
    if (!isValidNumber(northMean) || !isValidNumber(southMean)) {
      console.log(`North mean: ${northMean}, South mean: ${southMean}`);
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    // 5. Validation & Final Answer
    console.log(`North pixels: ${northStats.count}, Mean avg_rad: ${northMean.toFixed(3)}`);
    console.log(`South pixels: ${southStats.count}, Mean avg_rad: ${southMean.toFixed(3)}`);
    console.log(`North>South: ${northMean > southMean}`);

    // Final tag
    if (northMean > southMean) {
      console.log('A');
    } else {
      console.log('B');
    }

  } catch (err) {
    console.log(`Error: ${err && err.message ? err.message : err}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
